spans.s: उक्त [ukta] उक्ति [ukti], उक्ति See under वच्.
Uttered, spoken (opp. to अनुमित or संभावित).
Indicated; असता छाययोक्ताय सदाभासाय ते नमः

. -क्तम् A speech, words collectively; a sentence. -क्तम्, -क्ता A stanza of four lines with one syllabic instant, (there being one long or two short syllables in each). -Comp. -अनुक्त a. spoken and not spoken. -उपसंहारः a brief description, resume, peroration, recapitulation. -निर्वाहः defending an assertion. -पुंस्कः a word (feminine or neuter) of which also a masculine exists, and the meaning of which differs from that of the masculine only by the notion of gender.-प्रत्युक्तम् speech and reply, discourse. -वर्जम् ind. except the case mentioned. -वाक्यम् a dictum, decree.
Speech, expression, statement; उक्ति- रर्थान्तरन्यासः स्यात् सामान्यविशेषयोः
The power of expression, the expressive power of a word; as in एकयोक्त्या पुष्पवन्तौ दिवाकरनिशाकरौ Ak.
A worthy speech or word, maxim.
